title: Any page of class print-article printed to PDF carries two full-page mask images per page from the article's…
summary: incident.designer@ (or whoever keeps app/site.css): any page of class print-article printed to PDF carries two full-page mask images per page from the article's box-shadow (about 100 KB a page); a print rule "article.print-article { box-shadow: none }" in app/site.css would lighten every such PDF, not only the journal's (app/journal/journal.css has it for the journal)
closes: The one it waits on answers, and the asking agent's status file no longer lists it.
